# 74151 - Data selector/multiplexer 8-1

Package DIP-16 · family 74 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/74151.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/74151.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 29 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![74151 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/74151.png) | ![74151 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-74151.png) | ![74151 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-74151.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

| 13 | D6 | input |  |  |  |
| 12 | D7 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | A | input |  |  | data select, least significant |
| 10 | B | input |  |  |  |
| 9 | C | input |  |  | data select, most significant |
| 7 | STROBE | enable | low |  | controls pins 5, 6; when not enabled: Y low, W high |
| 5 | Y | output |  | totem-pole |  |
| 6 | W | output |  | totem-pole |  |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 5 | Y = STROBE' AND ((C' AND B' AND A' AND D0) OR (C' AND B' AND A AND D1) OR (C' AND B AND A' AND D2) OR (C' AND B AND A AND D3) OR (C AND B' AND A' AND D4) OR (C AND B' AND A AND D5) OR (C AND B AND A' AND D6) OR (C AND B AND A AND D7)) | With STROBE low, Y follows the data input D0-D7 picked by C,B,A. STROBE high forces Y low. |
| 6 | W = NOT Y | Complement of Y; STROBE high forces W high. |

## Not known

- The datasheet read is for the SN74151A (the 'A' version); the original SN74151 without suffix was not found as a separate datasheet.

## Notes

whenInactive for STROBE is not one of the single words in FORMAT.md: the two outputs go to different levels (Y low, W high). The '151A has address buffers with symmetrical delays through the complementary paths.

## Sources

- [TI The TTL Data Book for Design Engineers, 2nd ed. (1976), section 7, TYPES SN54150, SN54151A, SN54152A, SN54LS151, SN54LS152, SN54S151, SN74150, SN74151A, SN74LS151, SN74S151 Data selectors/multiplexers, bulletin DL-S 7611819 (revised October 1976)](http://www.bitsavers.org/components/ti/_dataBooks/1976_TI_The_TTL_Data_Book_2ed/07.pdf) - book pages 7-157 to 7-160 (PDF pages 156-159); SN74151A
